description: SSH into remote envs (key or sshpass) + read-only ps/logs/env inspector for docker or k8s
setup: Needs ssh (and sshpass when an env uses password auth): sudo dnf install sshpass / apt install sshpass / brew install hudochenkov/sshpass/sshpass
cp _tools/ssh/.env.example _tools/ssh/.env and fill one block per env (ask the user for hosts/passwords)
Fill the env table in .claude/skills/remote-env-inspect/SKILL.md, including whether each env holds real data
